stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard item-verdict [-h] --item ITEM [--plan PLAN]
                                      [--ask ASK] [--head HEAD]
                                      --evidence EVIDENCE [--all]
                                      [--as {tester}] --result {pass,fail}
                                      [scenario]

positional arguments:
  scenario              The scenario id in the item's plan (S1, U2, ...)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --item ITEM           The work item: owner/repo#N of an ISSUE (a pull
                        request is refused: use prove/verdict --pr)
  --plan PLAN           Only repeats the plan the issue body links with
                        `PLAN:`
  --ask ASK             The ask whose Done-when the plan must cover
  --head HEAD           The item's reference commit (default: the one pinned
                        at registration)
  --evidence EVIDENCE   A link, or what you ran and saw
  --all                 Every scenario of the plan this item may claim and the
                        tester judges
  --as {tester}         Only tester verdicts: `ci` is recorded by `gates item-
                        ci-record`
  --result {pass,fail}
